entities.summary: Sarah Margaret "Molly" Scott Cato is a British Green politician, economist and activist. She served as a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) for South West England from 2014 to 2020. From 2012, until her election as an MEP, she was Professor of Strategy and Sustainability at the University of Roehampton. Scott Cato speaks for the Green Party on finance and the EU, and is known for her work in the field of co-operative studies. She has published on green economics, localism and anti-capitalism, and has contributed to works on the risks of nuclear power, the use of which she strongly opposes.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent Green Party politician and economist, Molly Scott Cato has contributed to discussions on green economics and localism, influencing policy decisions in the European Parliament. Her work on co-operative studies and anti-capitalism has also shaped the party's stance on finance and EU policies.
